title: The Best Smart Sunrise Alarm Clocks
subtitle: Sunrise alarm clocks with app control and sleep sounds, ranked.
intro: We pulled the sunrise alarm clocks on Amazon with app control and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: sunrise light, sound machine, and app schedules.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: REACHER Smart Sunrise Alarm Clock (R7)
awards.why: REACHER's R7 brightens over 5 to 60 minutes, has a full wind-down routine, and charges no monthly fees.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.name: ANJANK App Smart Sunrise Alarm Clock
awards.why: 15 alarms, 5 sunrise modes, and 25 sleep sounds over Wi-Fi for $39.99.

awards.label: Best Voice Control
awards.name: NEEWER NF03 Sunrise Alarm Clock
awards.why: The only clock here that works with Alexa and Google, with RGB-IC lighting.

awards.label: Best Premium
awards.name: Dekala Arches Gradual Sunrise Alarm Clock
awards.why: Dekala's Arches adds a wireless charger and Bluetooth speaker.

systems_note: Only clocks whose listings name Wi-Fi are included. Hatch's Restore 3 doesn't say how it connects and charges $5.99/month for Hatch+ after a trial; several popular clocks are Bluetooth only.

buyers_guide.a: Many people wake up more easily to light that brightens over 20 to 30 minutes before the alarm, especially in dark winter months. It's a gentler start, not a cure for poor sleep.
Schedules for weekdays and weekends, custom sounds and colors, and wind-down routines without touching the clock. Some lock premium sounds and content behind a subscription.
Yes. Many double as a sound machine and a stay-in-bed light that turns green when it's OK to get up.
